scope: Local amendment evidence mapping only. No provider form, field validation, verified work identity, authority, submission or receipt. Inspect the current authorized Member Hub before a separately authorized operation.

existing work ID.next_step: Bind the exact existing work in the case to supporting provider identity evidence. Corroborate that record before editing; do not create a duplicate registration.

current record.next_step: Map the current work record and preserve the prior submission history that explains its values. Keep each original observation or receipt as evidence with its own source ID/version.

evidenced correction.next_step: Map evidence supporting the proposed correction against the current record. Preserve original and proposed values and affected interests; an evidence mapping does not approve the change.
evidenced correction.basis: Existing-work edits are documented by The MLC; evidence and affected-interest review follow the local catalog contract.

amendment_review.superseded_history: Preserve prior submissions and original values separately from the proposed correction. The MLC distinguishes submitted, accepted, rejected and superseded; preparation does not assign any provider status.
amendment_review.affected_interests_and_authority: Review affected interests, mandate, territory, effective period and original disclosure before any change. Supplied role and complete evidence mappings do not establish authority.
amendment_review.operation_scope: Keep a technical correction distinct from an ordinary existing-interest claim or an adverse rights dispute. The helper does not classify source contents; do not relabel another operation to pass this profile.
amendment_review.accepted_record: After any separately authorized operation, verify corrected fields on the accepted work separately from a submission receipt, preserving the previous record and unresolved observations.

review_basis: MLC instructions document existing-work editing and registration statuses. Evidence preservation, operation separation and authority review are local catalog safeguards, not provider form fields.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect the actual current work, editing route, account role and applicable authority before a separately authorized correction.
A prepared packet does not report submission, acceptance or observed correction. Retain raw provider history only when actually supplied or observed.
